summary: Original bound evidence supports complete three-dataset H2a full50 and the negative primary decision0/3. No blocking integrity defect identified; four nonblocking qualifications remain.
auditor: Fresh Codex reviewer; actual backend UNATTESTED

findings.finding: Three complete new endpoints use seed42 and best official development mAP. This does not establish held-out generalization, multi-seed stability, significance or SOTA.
findings.claim_impact: The registered three-dataset negative decision is supported with development and seed qualifiers.

findings.finding: Original text, hashes, complete counts and saved AP/rank arithmetic are checked. Images, checkpoints and distance binaries were not independently inspected or rescored locally. Canonical evidence_check.py remains UNRESOLVED.
findings.claim_impact: Receipt-backed completion is supported. Do not label this audit an independent binary replication or fresh observation of remote artifact presence.

findings.finding: All own-global metric vectors equal the sealed independent-global curve at fused-selected epochs8/38/26. RGBNT100 global-best selects7, so own-global minus global-best compares26 against7.
findings.claim_impact: Metric equality at the selected same epoch is supported; weight, feature, whole-trajectory identity and causal global-path effects are not established.

findings.finding: Same-modal geometry loss/match and Q-K entropy/mapped mass L1 are self-supervised diagnostics. RGBNT201 late-role entropy is near log128 while mapped L1 is near zero, so low mapped L1 need not mean semantic correspondence.
findings.claim_impact: Only proxy consistency/attention observations are supported; no reliable cross-spectral part or identity mechanism claim.

gt_provenance.details: Complete dataset identity/camera/scene metadata, disjoint train/evaluation IDs, every valid query and logged training label checked; pinned upstream metric functions actually called.

score_normalization.details: Standard AP/CMC denominators and representation L2; no prediction-statistic normalization of reported retrieval performance. All numerical differences assessed under unchanged1e-5 percentage-point tolerance.

result_existence.details: All requested local text and digests pass; original phases, all histories, accepted matrices and output receipts agree. Remote binary evidence is receipt-backed, not independently rescored locally.

dead_code.details: Every metric used for an H2a claim is in the original executed pipeline and has matching output evidence. Inactive legacy OOF/visualization helpers are not claimed H2a evidence.

scope.details: One fixed H2a condition per dataset, seed42, all three fresh full50 endpoints, six sealed historical controls, consumed official development checkpoint selection; primary0/3.

eval_type.details: Geometry targets are known same-image/same-modality visible pixel overlap. Other-view model features are not identity GT. Geometry/attention diagnostics do not provide cross-spectral part labels.

scope.checkpoint_selection: maximum official development fused mAP; latest epoch on exact tie
scope.own_global_selection: same fused-selected checkpoint; never independently selected

limitations: No original image, checkpoint or distance binary was transferred or rescored.
Remote execution and binary existence are evidenced by original source-bound receipts; not independently observed by this audit.
No canonical evidence_check.py invocation; its prior UNRESOLVED status is not rewritten.
Reaggregation of saved AP/rank/step records is independent deterministic text validation, not fresh evaluation.
